name: 9 EMA Grok bot
tagline: Sweeps a watchlist for 9 EMA pullback entries and drafts an order ticket for each
description: A screener built around one specific setup: price pulling back into the nine-day exponential average. It walks your watchlist and drafts a complete order ticket for each candidate, and it only counts an entry once a candle has actually closed through the line - a wick that pokes through and fails does not qualify.
author: rightwingink1
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
